decision: The channel envelope proves and achieves zero out-of-cube pixels while retaining strong adaptive mean gains, but it does not preserve the stricter epsilon-interior product boundary and AY3 P95 is 0.4% worse than global. The fixed BJ1 representation closes without coefficient, envelope, grid, rank, regularization, predictor or gate tuning.
forbidden_rescue: do not reinterpret zero out-of-cube as zero new product-boundary pixels
do not tune the BJ1 envelope, coefficient range, grid, rank, regularization, predictor, target, AO6 or gates
do not download confirmation data or run visual review
do not make film, stock, calibration, preference or product claims
allowed_next: one separately preregistered strict-epsilon-interior explicit residual basis may test the remaining identified representation gap; it must not alter BJ1 or reuse confirmation language
claim_ceiling: negative development decision for one intrinsically cube-preserving adaptive LUT with positive prediction evidence but failed strict-boundary and one fresh-tail gate
